subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Analisar relações intertextuais e interdiscursivas entre obras de diferentes autores e gêneros literários de um mesmo momento histórico e de momentos históricos diversos, explorando os modos como a literatura e as artes em geral se constituem, dialogam e se retroalimentam.

components.description_pt: Identificar relações intertextuais entre obras do mesmo e de diferentes períodos históricos
components.description_en: Identify intertextual relationships between works from the same and from different historical periods
components.cc_component_description: Compare how two or more texts from the same literary period treat similar themes or topics

components.description_pt: Analisar como obras literárias e artísticas dialogam e se informam mutuamente
components.description_en: Analyze how literary and artistic works enter into dialogue with and mutually inform one another
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how an analogy or allusion to another text shapes meaning and tone

components.description_pt: Explicar como relações intertextuais e interdiscursivas contribuem para constituição de gêneros literários
components.description_en: Explain how intertextual and interdiscursive relations contribute to the constitution of literary genres
components.cc_component_description: Explain how structural features of a text contribute to a reader's understanding of its content

cc_matches.description: Apply grades 11—12 Reading standards to literature (e.g., "Demonstrate knowledge of eighteenth-, nineteenth- and early-twentieth-century foundational works of American literature, including how two or more texts from the same period treat similar themes or topics").

Determine the meaning of words and phrases as they are used in a text, including figurative, connotative, and technical meanings; analyze the impact of specific word choices on meaning and tone, including analogies or allusions to other texts.
Describe the overall structure (e.g., chronology, comparison, cause/effect, problem/solution) of events, ideas, concepts, or information in a text or part of a text.
